questions.text: What is a broad topic you know exceptionally well?
What's a niche within that topic where you have even more profound expertise?
Who do you help in this niche (industry, role, type of business)? This person should make the decision or be part of the decision process. If multiple people, please articulate.
What specific problem do you help them overcome? What is the 'thing' you want to be closely aligned with and known for?
What clear, tangible outcome do you help them achieve?
How would you describe your brand's personality and core values? Let's get to the essence of your brand here.
What unique or 'weird' traits set you apart from others in your field?
What personal experiences or insights influence your approach and philosophy?
What do you do—beyond just a title—and what problems do you solve?
Who exactly do you serve (specific industry, audience, or niche)?
What makes your approach different? (Consider mindset, frameworks, or unique methodologies.)
What are your core services or offers (e.g., coaching, consulting, courses, etc.)?
What common misconceptions about your industry do you challenge?
What do people often misunderstand about what you do?
How would you describe your writing style? Add depth, be weird, be you.
Do you prefer to be provocative or more reserved in your communications? Explain why. A scenario-based example will help you understand this better.
What's your ideal balance between storytelling, insights, and direct advice?
Do you lean toward using analogies, pop culture, sport, adventure, 'other' references, or personal stories or a combination of?
Are there any signature phrases or expressions you frequently use? i.e. 'ya no lekker bru'
What writing formats feel most natural to you (short-form posts, long-form articles, carousels)?
What are the main goals of your content (brand awareness, credibility, engagement, lead generation, etc.)?
What are the common pain points or frustrations your audience experiences?
What are the key wants and aspirations your ideal clients wants?
What emotions do you want your audience to feel when they engage with your content?
What is the number one challenge your audience struggles with that you solve?
What objections do potential clients typically have before they decide to work with you?
Where do you see your brand or business in the next 3–5 years?
What long-term impact do you want to make in your industry?
What key performance indicators (KPIs) or success metrics do you use to measure progress?
How do you know when you've achieved your content and business goals?
